Their skill, ingenuity, and determination have fueled our economy and carried American manufacturing to new heights. I was also proud to sign the Working Families Tax Cuts Act into law — landmark legislation that makes the Small Business Tax Deduction permanent and allows American manufacturers to immediately expense 100 percent of their factory, machinery, equipment, and domestic research and development investments.
